An empty data_as_elements list turns data-as off

```elixir title="Elixir"
options_value = %HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions{data_as_elements: []}
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<div><span data-as=\"p\">First</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second</span></div>", options_value)
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
